name: jev-toolkit-monitor
description: EXPERIMENTAL Claude Code mod that watches the agent's own tool calls and flags or blocks risky ones.

plugins.name: jev-monitor
plugins.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Watches the agent's own tool calls (never your typing): edits to its instruction files, writes outside the project, unlisted network targets and other risky shapes. Starts in monitor mode (log and warn only). Reduces risk; does not make an agent safe. Needs the jev-toolkit-monitor Python package installed.
